blocks.html: Foam plastic insulation of not more than 2,000 British thermal units per square foot (Btu/sq. ft.) (22.7 MJ/m 2 ) as determined by NFPA 259 shall be permitted as a siding backer board with a maximum thickness of 1/2-inch (12.7 mm) without a thermal barrier, provided it is separated from the interior of the building by not less than 2 inches (51 mm) of mineral fiber insulation or equivalent or where applied as insulation over existing wall construction.
